mapper.select: SELECT * FROM drug_info WHERE drug_code = #{drugCode} AND status = 1

SELECT d.id, d.drug_code as drugCode, d.drug_name as drugName, d.specification, d.unit, COALESCE(rp.price, 0) as retailPrice, COALESCE(ip.price, 0) as insurancePrice FROM drug_info d LEFT JOIN drug_price rp ON d.id = rp.drug_id AND rp.price_type = 'RETAIL' AND rp.expire_date IS NULL LEFT JOIN drug_price ip ON d.id = ip.drug_id AND ip.price_type = 'INSURANCE' AND ip.expire_date IS NULL WHERE d.status = 1
AND d.drug_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{drugCode}, '%')
AND d.drug_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{drugName}, '%')
AND d.category_code = #{categoryCode}
ORDER BY d.drug_name
